messages.content: Compare the Aloft with the less expensive hotel east of Hillsboro before I leave the current reservation in place. I need the full four-night amounts after tax, parking, and breakfast, plus realistic weekday drives to the facility and Friday morning drives to PDX.

The current Aloft Hillsboro-Beaverton booking is $1,016.44 after tax, but it excludes breakfast and charges $15 per night for parking. A breakfast-inclusive rate is available for the same room. With that rate and four nights of parking, the complete hotel cost would be $1,156.44. The eastern option is Hyatt Place Portland Airport/Cascade Station at $936.28 after tax, with self-parking and breakfast included. It is $220.16 less.
What do the drives look like on Tuesday through Thursday? The audit starts at 8:00 each morning and should finish around 5:00.

From Aloft, the morning drive to the Hillsboro facility is generally 9-16 minutes; allowing 20 minutes would cover ordinary weekday variation. The return after 5:00 p.m. is usually 12-22 minutes. From Hyatt Place, the morning westbound trip is typically 38-58 minutes and can reach about 70 minutes after a crash or heavy congestion. The eastbound return is commonly 45-70 minutes.
So the eastern hotel could add close to two hours of driving on a bad audit day. How much does it help Friday? I need to return the car by 7:45 for the 10:20 flight.

Hyatt Place is about 6-10 minutes from the PDX rental return, so leaving around 7:25 a.m. would be sufficient. Aloft is normally 32-45 minutes at that hour. A 6:50 a.m. departure would provide a reasonable buffer for fuel and the rental return; 6:40 would be safer if rain or a traffic incident is reported.
Verify whether breakfast at Aloft is actually available early enough on Friday. Also check the cancellation terms for both rates, not just the hotels generally.

The Aloft breakfast-inclusive rate provides a daily breakfast credit. Breakfast begins at 6:30 a.m., so Friday would be rushed if you leave at 6:50; the hotel can instead prepare a cold takeaway bag if requested by 8:00 p.m. Thursday. That rate can be canceled without charge through 11:59 p.m. local time on August 13. Hyatt Place serves breakfast from 6:00 a.m. and its quoted rate is refundable through 6:00 p.m. local time on August 12. After those deadlines, each property charges one night plus tax.
Does the Aloft amount include the takeaway breakfast and all parking taxes or fees? I do not want another estimate that leaves a hotel charge outside the comparison.

Yes. The $1,156.44 Aloft total consists of the breakfast-inclusive room rate and taxes plus $60 for four nights of self-parking. The breakfast credit or Friday takeaway bag is covered by the rate, and the hotel confirmed there is no separate parking tax or destination fee. Hyatt Place remains $936.28 with breakfast, parking, and taxes included.
Give me the schedule comparison in practical terms. I am weighing the $220.16 against reliability, not amenities.

Aloft requires roughly 55-100 minutes of total driving across the three audit days, then about 32-45 minutes Friday morning. Hyatt Place requires roughly 249-384 minutes across the audit days, then 6-10 minutes Friday. The eastern hotel saves about half an hour on Friday but may add three to nearly five hours over the full stay, with most of that exposure immediately before and after fixed audit hours.
Keep Aloft. Change it to the breakfast-inclusive rate, include the four nights of parking, and arrange the Friday takeaway bag. Confirm that the room dates and cancellation deadline do not move.

The hotel can make all three changes without altering the August 14-18 stay or the August 13 at 11:59 p.m. local cancellation deadline. The revised hotel amount will be $1,156.44, which raises the complete trip projection from $1,718.44 to $1,858.44.
Proceed, and make sure the confirmation shows breakfast, parking, and the takeaway request rather than leaving them as verbal notes.

Aloft confirmation AL7H26 has been revised for August 14-18 at $1,156.44. The written confirmation now lists daily breakfast, self-parking for all four nights, and one Friday cold takeaway breakfast for pickup at 6:35 a.m. The reservation remains cancelable through 11:59 p.m. local time August 13. United record P8L4TR and rental PDX3C84 are unchanged, and the revised projected trip total is $1,858.44. For Friday, plan to leave Aloft by 6:50 a.m. for the 7:45 rental return and 10:20 flight.
